verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Slate only as an interactive TUI agent, with sessions, Tab queueing, steering, hotkeys and subagent cards. No headless, print, or non-interactive scripting mode is documented. The `--dangerously-skip-permissions`/`--yolo` flag only bypasses approval prompts, which is an adjacent control and does not show the agent can be invoked from scripts for workflow automation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the agent non-interactively in scripts for workflow automation
